traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Brain-Rending Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the death's head's next turn.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Ankhtepot dies, he revives with all his Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Har'Akir.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Ankhtepot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Ankhtepot has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Ankhtepot casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

At will: Dispel Magic; Divination; Mage Hand (hand is Invisible); Power Word Stun

1/day each: Animate Dead, Sunburst

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ankhtepot makes four Negative Energy Burst attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Power Word Stun.

actions.name: Negative Energy Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Touch of Death (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Ankhtepot touches one creature within 5 feet. If the creature has 80 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death Strike
actions.desc: Ankhtepot makes one Negative Energy Burst attack.

actions.name: Hand of Fate
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Ankhtepot can see within 60 feet. Failure: 14 (2d8 + 5) Force damage, and the target is pushed or pulled up to 20 feet straight away or toward Ankhtepot. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Sands of Time
actions.desc: Ankhtepot teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Ankhtepot at his destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage, and the target magically ages 10 years. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Azalin dies and his spirit jar remains intact, he revives with all his Hit Points in 2d10 days in the unoccupied space nearest his spirit jar. If Azalin's spirit jar is destroyed, he instead revives in 4d10 days in Castle Avernus in Darkon.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Azalin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Azalin casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

At will: Detect Magic; Detect Thoughts; Dispel Magic; Invisibility; Lightning Bolt (level 5 version); Mage Hand; Prestidigitation

2/day each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Modify Memory, Plane Shift, Scrying; 1/day each: Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill

traits.name: Siphon Spell
traits.desc:
Azalin casts Counterspell in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target creature fails its saving throw against this Counterspell, Azalin steals knowledge of the triggering spell. For 1 hour or until Azalin takes this Reaction again, Azalin can cast that spell once, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

At will: Counterspell

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Azalin makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Azalin's next turn.

actions.name: Eldritch Teleport
actions.desc: Azalin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and makes one Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch attack.

actions.name: Forbidden Knowledge
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 20, up to three creatures Azalin can see within 60 feet. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of Azalin's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Azalin can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

traits.name: Podling Link
traits.desc: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it. When the plant dies, its podlings also die.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If the plant dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days. This trait doesn't function if the plant is reduced to 0 Hit Points by Poison damage or its remains are sprinkled with salt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The plant makes three Vine attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Entrapping Pod.

actions.name: Vine
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 20 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of four vines.

actions.name: Entrapping Pod
actions.desc:
Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the plant is grappling. Failure: The target is pulled into the plant's space, is no longer Grappled, and is trapped in the plant's pod. While trapped, the target has the Blinded and Paralyzed conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the pod. After 2d4 hours, the trapped target dies, and if it was a Humanoid, a Bodytaker Podling resembling it emerges from the pod.

A creature outside the pod and within 5 feet of the plant can take an action to make a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target is removed from the pod, falls in a space within 5 feet of the plant, and has the Prone condition. If the plant dies, the trapped target is no longer Blinded or Paralyzed and can escape from the pod using 5 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: Transfer Harm
actions.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the plant while a podling is within 5 feet of the plant. Response: The plant halves the damage it takes from that attack, and the podling takes the other half of the damage.

languages.as_string: Deep Speech plus one other language

traits.name: Semblance of Life
traits.desc: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant. The podling has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to pass as the digested creature. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Abduct
traits.desc: The boneless needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

traits.name: Compression
traits.desc: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Smother
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the boneless's turns. The boneless can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling a target, the boneless can't take this action again.

actions.name: Unraveling Flesh (1/Day)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature within 30 feet that can see the boneless. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition. Failure or Success: The boneless moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

languages.as_string: telepathy 60 ft. understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Detect Intelligence
traits.desc: The brain magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The brain has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

At will: Charm Person; Detect Thoughts; Mage Hand

1/day each: Compulsion, Hold Person (level 3 version)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The brain makes two Disrupting Burst attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Psychic damage. The target can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of the brain's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The carrion stalker makes two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target. While attached, the carrion stalker can't make Tentacle attacks against other targets.

The carrion stalker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the carrion stalker as an action.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the carrion stalker is attached to the target), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned in this way, the target is infested with a carrion stalker larva. If the target is still Poisoned in this way after 24 hours, the effect ends as the larva becomes a fully grown Carrion Stalker, which bursts from the target's chest and kills it.

actions.name: Silver Needle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a carrionette, it is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, the target has the Poisoned condition, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

actions.name: Soul Swap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Charisma Saving Throw: DC 11, one Humanoid the carrionette can see within 15 feet that is cursed by its Silver Needle. Failure: The carrionette possesses the target's body, and the target possesses the carrionette's body and has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour. While possessing another body, the carrionette and target retain their alignments; personalities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and languages known. They otherwise adopt the other creature's game statistics, though the target can't use this Soul Swap action.

The possession is undone if the target (while in the carrionette's body) deals damage to the carrionette (in the target's original body) with its Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Chakuna dies and her heart remains intact, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Valachan. Chakuna's heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

traits.name: Experienced Hunter
traits.desc: Difficult Terrain composed of undergrowth doesn't cost Chakuna extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Chakuna makes three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 Hit Points, it instead becomes a werepanther under the DM's control and has 10 Hit Points (use the Weretiger stat block). Success: The target is immune to Chakuna's curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage and the target receives a dire wound if it doesn't have one. While the target is wounded, its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to staunch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The spear magically returns to Chakuna's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Prowl (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Chakuna moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, she can take the Hide action.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: Chakuna shape-shifts into a Large panther-humanoid hybrid or a Large panther, or she returns to her true humanoid form. Her game statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.desc: Chakuna moves up to half her Speed and makes one Scratch attack.

actions.name: Strike from Shadows
actions.desc: Chakuna makes one Barbed Spear attack. If Chakuna has the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Sudden Bite
actions.desc: Chakuna uses Shape-Shift to turn into her hybrid form or panther form and then makes one Bite attack. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Cthulhu dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks inside the Vault of Cthulhu.

traits.name: Impossible Geometry
traits.desc: Ground, air, and water in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Cthulhu is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Cthulhu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

At will: Mind Spike (level 4 version)

3/day each: Dream, Geas (can target creatures through dreams); 1/day each: Befuddlement, Plane Shift (self only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Cthulhu makes three Eldritch Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast Befuddlement if available or Mind Spike (level 4 version). It can replace one Eldritch Claw attack with a use of Tentacle.

actions.name: Eldritch Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d8 + 9) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from one of two limbs.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by Cthulhu. Failure: 21 (6d6) Acid damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Psychic damage taken, and Cthulhu regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Warp
actions.desc: Cthulhu teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet, taking creatures it is grappling with it. Then each creature within 10 feet of the space it left is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 25. Failure: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Clamp
actions.desc: Cthulhu makes an Eldritch Claw attack.

actions.name: Fold Space
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point Cthulhu can see within 60 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage, and the target is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Cthulhu that is horizontal to it. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Cthulhu can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Overhanging Branches
traits.desc: The tree's allies can willingly end their moves in the tree's space. Allies in the tree's space have Half Cover.

traits.name: Unholy Regrowth
traits.desc: If the tree dies, 2d6 Death's Head Trees regrow around the same place in 365 days unless the tree is killed by a creature under the effect of a Bless spell using a weapon that deals Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tree makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Exploding Head
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the tree can see within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the creature has the Poisoned condition until the start of the tree's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Head Fruits
actions.desc: Each Undead ally in the tree's space can immediately take a Reaction to gain 5 Temporary Hit Points.

languages.as_string: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.desc: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the dullahan and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the dullahan can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the dullahan instead.

traits.name: Terrorizer
traits.desc: The dullahan has Advantage on attack rolls against targets that have the Frightened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dullahan makes two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

actions.name: Beheading Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, it dies and its head is lopped off. The head rises as a Death's Head in the space of the target's corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The head is under the dullahan's control. The dullahan can control no more than seven heads at a time.

actions.name: Fiery Skull
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Headless Wail
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, up to three creatures within 120 feet of the dullahan that aren't Constructs or Undead. Failure: 13 (2d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the dullahan's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.desc: If Ebonbane dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 weeks, teleporting somewhere in Shadowborn Manor. Until it revives, Ebonbane acts as a +3 Longsword when wielded by a creature.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
traits.desc: If Ebonbane fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Ebonbane has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ebonbane makes three Darkflame Slash attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Possess Dead if available.

actions.name: Darkflame Slash
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Possess Dead (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Ebonbane raises a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse within 5 feet of itself and possesses it. The corpse wields Ebonbane and is under its control. Ebonbane gains 50 Temporary Hit Points, and its statistics are the same, except its Speed increases to 30 feet, and it can speak through the corpse using any language the corpse knew in life.

The possession lasts until Ebonbane drops to 0 Hit Points or Ebonbane ends the possession as a Bonus Action. Once the possession ends, Ebonbane can't possess the corpse again. The corpse crumbles to dust 24 hours after the possession ends.

actions.name: Worthy Wielder
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17, one willing Humanoid within 5 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, Ebonbane devours its soul. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Ebonbane can be restored to life only by a Wish spell. Success: The target attunes to Ebonbane and can wield the sword.

actions.name: Parry
actions.desc: Trigger: Ebonbane is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: Ebonbane adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: Retaliate
actions.desc: Ebonbane moves up to half its Speed and makes one Darkflame Slash attack.

actions.name: Runic Flare
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature of Ebonbane's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from Ebonbane. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute. Failure or Success: Ebonbane can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The elder thing has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Eldritch Magic (3/Day)
traits.desc:
The elder thing casts Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, or Nondetection, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).

3/day: Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, Nondetection

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elder thing makes two Soothing Tentacle attacks and uses Psychic Skewer.

actions.name: Soothing Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the elder thing's next turn.

actions.name: Mind-Scouring Spores (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the elder thing. Failure: 55 (10d10) Psychic damage. For 1 minute, whenever the target takes the Magic action, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Psychic Skewer
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 60 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage. If the target has the Charmed condition, it gains 1 Exhaustion level and has the Stunned condition while Charmed.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Ez casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

At will: Light; Mage Hand

1/day each: Dispel Evil and Good, Lightning Bolt, Magic Circle

traits.name: Shield (3/Day)
traits.desc:
Ez casts Shield in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

3/day: Shield

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ez makes three attacks, using Hunter's Blade or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Hunter's Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Fire damage.

actions.name: Bolster Allies
actions.desc: Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her has Ez's choice of (A) Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn or (B) Resistance to Acid, Necrotic, and Poison damage until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Curse of the All-Seeing Eye (1/Day)
actions.desc:
Ez chooses a damage type. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one target within 30 feet that Ez can see. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target has Vulnerability to the chosen damage type. The curse ends early if Ez uses this action again.

If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the curse ends, Ez can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.

actions.name: Inspiring Rally
actions.desc: Ez chooses up to six allies within 60 feet. Each target that can hear her can take a Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Aura of Violence
traits.desc: At the end of each of the gallows speaker's turns, each creature of the gallows speaker's choice in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the gallows speaker suffers the following effect. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target takes a Reaction to make a melee attack roll against a creature within reach. If no creature is within reach, the target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Whirling Form
traits.desc: The gallows speaker can enter a creature's space and stop there.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gallows speaker makes two Whirling Blades attacks.

actions.name: Whirling Blades
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Howling Wind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened in this way, the creature has the Deafened condition, is compelled to shriek along with the gallows speaker, and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Suppressed Lycanthropy
traits.desc: If reduced to 0 Hit Points, Gennifer succumbs to lycanthropy. Her statistics are replaced by those of the Werewolf stat block, but she retains her alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; proficiencies; and languages known. She then immediately revives in her hybrid form with all her Hit Points.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Gennifer casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

At will: Light; Mending

1/day each: Locate Animals or Plants, Magic Circle, Protection from Poison

traits.name: Occult Aid (2/Day)
traits.desc:
Gennifer casts Healing Word, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

2/day: Healing Word

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Gennifer makes two attacks, using Blessed Dagger or Radiant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Blessed Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Wisp
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Esoteric Ward (Recharge 6)
